snippet.title: Fatal Train – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A co-op detective game where the killer is not one of the players. The train is packed with passengers, full of clues, and has many cars, from casinos to bars and huge libraries

Fatal Train is a 4-player investigation game set on a moving train.
Each time the train enters a tunnel - someone dies.

Every time, the train is different, with different events and different events. The train might get caught in a thunderstorm, it might pass through a cemetery that brings all the dead back to life, it might pass through a swarm of mechanical birds that peck out your eyes, or it might even catch fire 

Demo coming May 2026

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193920/Fatal_Train/
And join to Discord server!
https://discord.gg/B3Qkdm8BW6

Good luck, detectives.
Every tunnel takes someone.
